func work(items: [Item]) async throws {
  for item in items {
    Task { try await read(item) }
    guard try await allowed(item) else { throw Denied() }
  }
}

func nonthrowingChecks(items: [Item]) async throws {
  for item in items {
    if await blocked(item) { throw Denied() }
  }
  for item in items {
    if (await blocked(item)) { throw Denied() }
  }
  for item in items {
    guard await allowed(item) else { throw Denied() }
  }
}
